about: Rank writes as it ranks: each bound is ranked and that RANK line is written before the next bound is touched. --out is the draft: the file holds the lines in the order they were ranked, and no later pass rewrites them.

cases.name: bound --as rank --out a file, on a kept fold
cases.printed: RANK     N region summaries read · 0 cells visited, then one RANK line per bound that bites, in bound order
cases.the file: the same RANK lines, appended as each bound was ranked

red was: rank collected every bite, sorted, and wrote once after the last bound
